items.Sentence: Secondary treatment processes generally include a combination of physical and biological treatment to remove biodegradable organics and suspended solids.
Advanced secondary facilities provide additional treatment beyond secondary (e.g., filtration).

This General Order covers municipal wastewater treatment facilities that provide disinfection using either chlorine or ultraviolet light (UV), but does not cover facilities that provide disinfection using alternative disinfection methods (e.g., ozonation or pasteurization).
